full_name: Kris Manjapra | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2015–2016 History Beatrice Shepherd Blane Fellow Tufts University
bio: Kris Manjapra, an associate professor of history at Tufts University, studies global and transnational intellectual history, with a special focus on the political economy and discourses of colonialism and resulting modes of resistance.
